newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Rio state publishes bid specs for gas firms sale.
newsitem.headline: Rio state publishes bid specs for gas firms sale.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro state government published Friday the bid specifications for the July 14 privatization auction of its gas company Companhia Estadual de Gas (CEG) and piped gas distributor Riogas.

The state government will sell off voting shares in CEG representing 65.41 percent of total capital and 58.87 percent of voting capital. CEG employees will be able to buy 8.18 percent of the voting shares, while the remaining 57.23 percent will be sold at auction.
The state is also offering voting and preference shares in Riogas worth 75 percent of total capital or 83.6 percent of voting capital and 70.6 percent of preference share capital.
The minimum price for the 1000 local time/1300 GMT closed-envelope auction on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange has been set at 560 million reais ($523.4 million).

Interested investors have until 1200 local time/1500 GMT on June 30 to pre-identify themselves for the auction and hand in the necessary documentation at the stock exchange clearing house. ((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
